acceptance: A fixture of a logged-out boot pane ends the boot at once with exit 85 and the pattern
Each of the three callers has a test
fix: Design first. Capture a logged-out boot pane in a scratch HOME as a fixture. Give bootTick a typed result that its three callers map to exit 85.
summary: bootTick handles rc 1, 4 and 86, and rc 85 falls through, so a logged-out CLI at boot waits for the prompt and ends at exit 80 with no pattern. Three callers map each error to ExitREPLBootTimeout. The frequency is not measured, because no logged-out boot pane is captured.
title: A login screen during boot ends as a boot timeout, not as a login failure
